title: Contract-Term Pricing Conditions for Summit Gold Status Awards in Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements
content:
**Condition.** For a Summit Gold status award redeemed from Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements company points, the remaining term is the number of whole calendar months from the redemption date to the agreement's current term end date. The remaining term decides how the net Gold award price — the price after any allowance taken off it — is charged:

| Remaining term | Price charged |
|---|---|
| fewer than 6 months | 50 percent of the net price, rounded up to the next whole step of 100 points |
| 6 months or more, and fewer than the tier's status-award validity months | the net price multiplied by the remaining months and divided by the validity months, rounded up to the next whole step of 100 points |
| the validity months or more | the net price in full |

The tier's status-award validity is counted in calendar months:

| Tier | Status-award validity (months) |
|---|---|
| Crestline Business Connect | 12 |
| Crestline Business Connect Plus | 12 |
| Crestline Corporate Select | 12 |
| Crestline Corporate Preferred | 12 |
| Crestline Corporate Premier | 12 |
| Crestline Corporate Strategic | 12 |

"Rounded up to the next whole step of 100 points" means raised to the nearest multiple of 100 points at or above the figure; a figure already on a multiple of 100 stays as it is.

### Worked figures (hypothetical net price of 3650 points, validity of 12 months)

| Remaining term | Computation | Charged |
|---|---|---|
| 4 months | 50 percent of 3650 is 1825, rounded up | 1900 points |
| 6 months | 3650 multiplied by 6, divided by 12, is 1825, rounded up | 1900 points |
| 9 months | 3650 multiplied by 9, divided by 12, is 2737.5, rounded up | 2800 points |
| 12 months | in full | 3650 points |
| 20 months | in full | 3650 points |

The points so charged, a whole number, are the points redeemed for the award.
